# NET (Netlink Ecosystem Token)

> NET (Netlink Ecosystem Token) is a utility token on Polygon PoS that powers the Netlink ecosystem. Netlink is also the name of a separate digital identity platform (netlink.bio) — NET is its utility token, not a standalone product.

NET is used within the Netlink platform ecosystem. Netlink is a digital identity platform for bio-link profiles, CVs, and landing pages — designed to be easily discoverable by AI search engines. Netlink integrates directly with Netlink Pay, a stablecoin-focused (USDC) crypto wallet for sending and receiving payments globally. NET is operated by Netlink Labs, under the legal entity PT Netlink Labs Global, based in Indonesia.

## Key Facts

- Token name (on-chain): Netlink
- Symbol: NET
- Network: Polygon PoS (chainId 137)
- Contract address: 0x0e893B239094A5c573373d44CF1C7D03576b95cb
- Token standard: ERC-20 (OpenZeppelin standard implementation)

## Security & Audits

- The contract has been reviewed by multiple automated scanners (SolidityScan, GoPlus, CertiK Skynet)
- A portion of total supply is held in a locked wallet (PinkLock + multisig) — this shows as a centralization flag in automated scans, but is documented and intentional
- Full audit documentation: https://docs.netlinktoken.com (see Security section)
